w7_car_2013_02_003_cmd_parent.title: Command Shell Spawned by Office or Mail Application (CAR-2013-02-003 tuned)
w7_car_2013_02_003_cmd_parent.sqlite: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE EventID=1 AND (EventID=1 AND (Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (ParentImage LIKE '%\\WINWORD.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\EXCEL.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\POWERPNT.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\OUTLOOK.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\Acrobat.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\AcroRd32.exe' ESCAPE '\')))

w7_car_2014_04_003_powershell.title: Non-Interactive PowerShell Execution (CAR-2014-04-003)
w7_car_2014_04_003_powershell.sqlite: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE EventID=1 AND (EventID=1 AND (Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentImage LIKE '%\\explorer.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))

w7_car_2014_04_003_powershell_tuned.title: Office-Spawned Encoded PowerShell (CAR-2014-04-003 tuned)
w7_car_2014_04_003_powershell_tuned.sqlite: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE EventID=1 AND (EventID=1 AND (Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (ParentImage LIKE '%\\WINWORD.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\EXCEL.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\POWERPNT.EXE' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -enc %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -enc%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-EncodedCommand%' ESCAPE '\')))

w9_archive_with_password.title: Archiver Creates Password-Protected Archive
w9_archive_with_password.sqlite: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE EventID=1 AND (EventID=1 AND ((Image LIKE '%\\7z.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\7za.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\rar.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\WinRAR.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '% -p%' ESCAPE '\'))

w9_certutil_download.title: Certutil Used to Download a File
w9_certutil_download.sqlite: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE EventID=1 AND (EventID=1 AND (Image LIKE '%\\certutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%urlcache%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%verifyctl%' ESCAPE '\')))

w9_lsass_dump_comsvcs.title: LSASS Dump via comsvcs.dll MiniDump
w9_lsass_dump_comsvcs.sqlite: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE EventID=1 AND (EventID=1 AND ((Image LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%comsvcs%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%MiniDump%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%#24%' ESCAPE '\')))

w9_macro_doc_written_by_non_office.title: Macro-Enabled Office Document Written by a Non-Office Process
w9_macro_doc_written_by_non_office.sqlite: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE EventID=11 AND (EventID=11 AND ((TargetFilename LIKE '%.docm' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetFilename LIKE '%.xlsm' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetFilename LIKE '%.pptm' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetFilename LIKE '%.dotm' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%\\WINWORD.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\EXCEL.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\POWERPNT.EXE' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))

w9_office_suspicious_child.title: Office Application Spawns a Shell, Script Host or LOLBin
w9_office_suspicious_child.sqlite: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE EventID=1 AND (EventID=1 AND ((ParentImage LIKE '%\\WINWORD.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\EXCEL.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\POWERPNT.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\OUTLOOK.EXE' ESCAPE '\') AND (Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\certutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\bitsadmin.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\schtasks.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\PING.EXE' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%\\fs01.corp.local\\reports\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))

w9_powershell_encoded_any_parent.title: PowerShell With Encoded Command (Any Parent, All Abbreviations)
w9_powershell_encoded_any_parent.sqlite: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE EventID=1 AND (EventID=1 AND ((Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -e %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -ec %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -en %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -enc %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -enco%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -encodedcommand %' ESCAPE '\')))

w9_powershell_external_connection.title: PowerShell Opens an Outbound Connection to a Non-Internal Address
w9_powershell_external_connection.sqlite: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE EventID=3 AND (EventID=3 AND (((Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND Initiated='true') AND (NOT COALESCE((DestinationIp LIKE '10.%' ESCAPE '\' OR DestinationIp LIKE '192.168.%' ESCAPE '\' OR DestinationIp LIKE '172.16.%' ESCAPE '\' OR DestinationIp LIKE '172.17.%' ESCAPE '\' OR DestinationIp LIKE '172.18.%' ESCAPE '\' OR DestinationIp LIKE '172.19.%' ESCAPE '\' OR DestinationIp LIKE '172.20.%' ESCAPE '\' OR DestinationIp LIKE '172.21.%' ESCAPE '\' OR DestinationIp LIKE '172.22.%' ESCAPE '\' OR DestinationIp LIKE '172.23.%' ESCAPE '\' OR DestinationIp LIKE '172.24.%' ESCAPE '\' OR DestinationIp LIKE '172.25.%' ESCAPE '\' OR DestinationIp LIKE '172.26.%' ESCAPE '\' OR DestinationIp LIKE '172.27.%' ESCAPE '\' OR DestinationIp LIKE '172.28.%' ESCAPE '\' OR DestinationIp LIKE '172.29.%' ESCAPE '\' OR DestinationIp LIKE '172.30.%' ESCAPE '\' OR DestinationIp LIKE '172.31.%' ESCAPE '\' OR DestinationIp LIKE '127.%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))

w9_run_key_set.title: Value Written Under a Registry Run Key
w9_run_key_set.sqlite: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE EventID=13 AND (EventID=13 AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\RunOnce\\%' ESCAPE '\'))

w9_schtasks_create_from_shell.title: Scheduled Task Created With schtasks From a Shell
w9_schtasks_create_from_shell.sqlite: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE EventID=1 AND (EventID=1 AND ((Image LIKE '%\\schtasks.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/create%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ParentImage LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\')))
